post.description:
Hospital login endpoint.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request object
    payload: Login credentials
    db: Database session
    
Returns:
    HospitalToken: Access token and hospital data
    
Raises:
    HTTPException: If credentials invalid or hospital not found

delete.description:
Delete hospital account.

Args:
    id: Hospital ID to delete
    db: Database session
    current_hospital: Current authenticated hospital
    
Raises:
    HTTPException: If unauthorized or hospital not found

put.description:
Update hospital details.

SECURITY FIX: Password field is properly hashed before storage.
Prevents plaintext password storage vulnerability.

Args:
    id: Hospital ID to update
    hospital: Updated hospital data
    db: Database session
    current_hospital: Current authenticated hospital
    
Returns:
    HospitalResponse: Updated hospital data
    
Raises:
    HTTPException: If unauthorized or hospital not found

Change hospital password securely.

Args:
    payload: Old and new password
    db: Database session
    current_hospital: Current authenticated hospital
    
Returns:
    dict: Success message
    
Raises:
    HTTPException: If old password incorrect or error occurs
